verdict.rationale: treg documents a large searchable catalog of 3,800+ provider endpoints. You search it by capability (`GET /catalog/search?q=backlinks`) and compare platforms side by side, and each endpoint lists its price, parameters and an example response. That covers the tools half of the story. However, the catalog is of upstream provider APIs proxied through treg, not a registry of third-party MCP servers, so the MCP-server browsing part is not evidenced. missing for 10: a catalog of MCP servers (not just treg-proxied provider endpoints), independent or hands-on corroboration that search and browse work as documented.

support.subject: As a developer, I can search and browse a large catalog of MCP servers and tools by capability before wiring anything into my agent

citations.quote: Search by what you want to _do_, not by vendor: `GET /catalog/search?q=backlinks`.
proxy a real request to any of 3,800+ catalogued provider endpoints through `/call/`
`/catalog/platforms/{slug}` lists them side by side with measured success rate, speed and price.
Every catalogued endpoint carries its price, parameters and an example response.
